name: TableOfFigures
description: Represents a single table of figures in a document. The TableOfFigures object is a member of the TablesOfFigures collection. The TablesOfFigures collection includes all the tables of figures in a document.
remarks: Use TablesOfFigures (Index), where Index is the index number, to return a single TableOfFigures object. The index number represents the position of the table of figures in the document. The following example updates the page numbers of the items in the first table of figures in the active document. Use the Add method to add a table of figures to a document. A table of figures lists figure captions in the order in which they appear in the document. The following example replaces the selection in the active document with a table of figures that includes caption labels and page numbers.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified TableOfFigures object.

properties.name: Caption
properties.description: Returns or sets the label that identifies the items to be included in a table of figures. Read/write String.

properties.name: IncludeLabel
properties.description: True if the caption label and caption number are included in a table of figures. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: RightAlignPageNumbers
properties.description: True if page numbers are aligned with the right margin in an table of figures. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: UseHeadingStyles
properties.description: True if built-in heading styles are used to create a table of figures. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: LowerHeadingLevel
properties.description: Returns or sets the ending heading level for a table of figures. Read/write Long.

properties.name: UpperHeadingLevel
properties.description: Returns or sets the starting heading level for a table of figures. Read/write Long.

properties.name: IncludePageNumbers
properties.description: True if page numbers are included in the table of figures. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Range
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents the portion of a document that is contained within the specified table of figures.

properties.name: UseFields
properties.description: True if Table of Contents Entry (TC) fields are used to create a table of figures. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: TableID
properties.description: Returns or sets a one-letter identifier that is used to build a table of figures from TOC fields. Read/write String.

properties.name: HeadingStyles
properties.description: Returns a HeadingStyles object that represents additional styles used to compile a table of contents or table of figures (styles other than the Heading 1 - Heading 9 styles). Read-only.

properties.name: TabLeader
properties.description: Returns or sets the character between entries and their page numbers in an table of figures. Read/write WdTabLeader.

properties.name: UseHyperlinks
properties.description: Returns or sets whether entries in a table of figures should be formatted as hyperlinks when publishing to the Web. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: HidePageNumbersInWeb
properties.description: Returns or sets whether page numbers in a table of contents or a table of figures should be hidden when publishing to the Web. Read/write Boolean.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes the specified table of figures.

methods.name: UpdatePageNumbers
methods.description: Updates the page numbers for items in a table of figures.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates the entries shown in a table of figures.
